meta.name: code-forge
meta.description: Generate implementation code from an approved design blueprint or verbal requirements. Composes context anchoring, architecture, clean code, DDD, security, and test quality into an inside-out implementation workflow. Use when moving from design to code, implementing approved contracts, or when the user says 'implement', 'code this', 'build it', 'forge the code', or 'generate the code'.

copy.tagline: 从设计蓝图或口头需求生成实现代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果从设计到编码需要自动化实现
copy.tagline_en: Generate implementation code from design blueprints or verbal requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate coding from design to implementation
